title: test(app-shell): sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet "every bare cookie-only call is a counted row" scans the whole ui source tree in ~5 s locally and ~15 s on a CI shard, and times out the required Test UI (1/16)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① fleet-measured flaky required check, filed at its first sighting (Tesla 2026-11-28 01:05Z 「同意」 to filing at the first eviction, not the second). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 · reach: every PR, since `Test UI (1/16)` is required and the case scans the whole tree whatever the diff touches · evidence: CI job 140828751977, local timing.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：app-shell 里一条令牌棘轮测试会扫描整个 ui 源码树。本地约 5 秒，CI 分片上约 15 秒，刚好压在 15 秒超时线上，会在完全无关的 PR 上偶发变红，挡住合并。
- 修法：让这条测试明显快于超时线（比如缓存或缩小扫描、只解析一次），不放宽断言。
- 要你做的：无。

## What fails

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`, case "every bare cookie-only call is a counted row…": `Test timed out in 15000ms` (15202 ms, job 140828751977, run 46096246586, PR #38089). The other 3 cases in the file pass.

## Evidence that it is timing, not a regression

- PR #38089 edits only `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`, which is outside the case's scan (`ui/packages/*/src` and the console src, non-test files).
- On the same head the file passes 4/4 locally, with this case at 5215 ms.
- AGENTS.md puts a single test file over 10 s on its own lane to fix.

## Acceptance

- The case runs well under the timeout on a CI shard (target under 5 s there), for example by parsing each file once and sharing the scan across the file's cases, or by narrowing the walk to the files that can hold a fetch call.
- The ratchet keeps its teeth: an ablation that adds a bare cookie-only call to a scanned file still reds it.
- No timeout is raised to hide it.
